name: 皮肤切换器-Skin Changer
author: Gurio
description: 切换角色、卡牌、怪物和先古场景皮肤；可在实战暂停菜单直接选择角色、怪物、先古之民或同伴，热切换皮肤并调整模型、血条与怪物意图。界面支持 15 种语言，无需重启。 Switch character, card, monster, and Ancient skins; select a character, monster, Ancient, or companion in-run to hot-swap skins and adjust the model, health bar, and monster intent. 15-language interface, no restart required.
